def run(Fb, tfun_names, tf):
    def res(k):
        G=tf(k[0]) 
        X=np.column_stack([f*G for f in Fb])
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
        return dP_dt-X@c
    best=None

    return best.x, np.var(dP_dt-X@c)/np.var(dP_dt), np.round(c,4)
